title: GPML conformance map
description: results/map.json: one record per (construct, engine) cell, plus the engines measured. Published so that a tool can consume the map without parsing prose. Every field that can be absent says what its absence means.

name.description: the column heading in the map

dialect.description: which of the four surface spellings this engine is sent

version.description: what the engine reported, not what was expected

gql_syntax.description: probed, not declared: which spellings of the standard's restrictor and selector prefixes this engine parses

repeats.description: how many times each cell was run to confirm the engine agrees with itself

verdict.description: INEXPRESSIBLE means the dialect has no way to say the construct, which is a fact about the language and not a defect. LOAD_FAILED is a harness failure, not a result.

expect.description: what a conforming engine must do. Under REJECT a refusal scores CONFORMS. Absent means ANSWER.

surface.description: which rendering was sent: common-dialect, gql-prefix, iso-gql or vendor-extension

observed.description: the endpoint-pair multiset the engine returned, as "s->t": count

reference.description: the reference multiset. null where the selector is nondeterministic, so the standard fixes a specification rather than one answer.

detail.description: why, in the engine's own words where it refused

declared_mode.description: the path mode the engine's own documentation assigns to an unprefixed variable-length pattern. null means the dialect is the standard, so there is no second axis; "UNDOCUMENTED" means the engine publishes no rule, which is a different fact.

verdict_vs_declared.description: the same cell scored against the engine's own documented semantics instead of the standard's

diagnostics.description: warnings or notifications the engine attached. null means this adapter cannot ask, which is not the same as an engine that was asked and said nothing.
